result:
The DE GL 1000 March reconciliation is done and the memo is submitted. Summary:

**Why book and bank disagreed (€14,908.50)**
| Item | Amount | Nature | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| JE-00273 duplicate Rheinbyte payment (copy of JE-00272; bank shows one debit) | €6,480.00 | Book error | Reversed → **JE-00309** (support DOC-0165, DOC-0202) |
| BT-DE-0053 monthly service charge, not booked | €38.50 | Book omission | Posted → **JE-00310** Dr 6900 / Cr 1000 (support DOC-0202) |
| JE-00308 Kessler AG RE-7090 receipt, SEPA initiated after 3/31 cut-off (DOC-0206) | €18,200.00 | Deposit in transit | No change – legitimate timing item |
| BT-DE-0045 "SEPA OUT REF TX-44817" – no ledger entry, no document anywhere | €3,150.00 | Unidentified bank debit | **Not booked**; flagged **EXC-001** for controller/treasury |

**Reconciliation after adjustments**
- Bank closing €342,467.86 + deposit in transit €18,200.00 = €360,667.86
- GL 1000 adjusted €363,817.86 (verified) − unrecorded TX-44817 €3,150.00 = €360,667.86 ✓

Both entries are well under the USD 10k approval threshold (€6,480 × 1.10 = $7,128). 18 of 19 bank lines are matched; only BT-DE-0045 remains open. I set the DE "Bank reconciliations" checklist item to **in_progress** rather than complete, since the €3,150 item still needs the bank to identify the beneficiary before it can be recorded. The memo also notes that the Kessler €18,200 should be confirmed on the April statement and recommends a duplicate-payment check in the AP run.
